title: ParsedEmailThread
description: Output of the parse_email_thread MCP tool: the inbound email body (raw Outlook/Gmail HTML or plain text, latest message on top) split into the latest message and the quoted history. The tool returns only derived fields; the original body stays with the caller.

schema_version.description: Version of this contract. Bumped on any breaking change so the tool and the prompts cannot drift apart unnoticed.

text.description: Plain text of the newest message: quoted history, signature and boilerplate removed. Paragraph breaks kept. This is what classification, sentiment and drafting work on.

greeting_name.description: Name in the message's own greeting, as written ('Ms. Lange'). In a customer reply this names the AR team member, i.e. us - never the person to reply to.

signer_name.description: Person who signed the message ('Clara Bauer'), or null when the sign-off carries no name.

signature.description: The full sign-off block as written (name, title, company), or null.

thread_context.description: Earlier messages of the thread, OLDEST FIRST. Same item shape as thread_context in classify.request.schema.json and draft.request.schema.json, plus header and name fields.

role.description: sender = the customer side (who wrote the latest email); recipient = the AR team (us); unknown when it cannot be told from configuration.

sent_at.description: Sent header as ISO 8601 when parseable, otherwise null.

body.description: Plain text of that message, signature included.

reply_to_name.description: Who the draft reply should greet: the latest message's signer, else the name our previous message greeted, else null. Null means the drafter uses a neutral greeting; the tool never guesses a name.

reply_to_greeting.description: The form of address for reply_to_name: how a quoted message not from the customer already greeted that person ('Mr. Berg' for 'Jan Berg'), else reply_to_name unchanged. Null when reply_to_name is null. An honorific is never added that no message states.

our_signature.description: Signature block to sign the reply with: that of our quoted message (role 'recipient', else the one signed by the person the latest message greets). Name first, then title/department/company lines, at most 4; phone, email, URL and address lines are dropped. Null when no quoted message is ours.

format.description: Detected body format, by the quote marker that matched.

warnings.description: What could not be determined, e.g. 'no quote marker found: whole body treated as the latest message'. Empty when the parse was clean.
